cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Get It on the Record
cards.instruction: Get formal approval, endorsement, or acknowledgment before anyone can quietly revise their position.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You've approved the festival budget. Sign each page before lunch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The front page will do. You said yes to the fireworks last year, too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Date your initials; I'll bring any changed pages back for a new signature.

reason: Create a real reduction from every page to front-page approval, and turn B past reversal into a dated re-signing procedure rather than a closing slogan.
